observations: One large rectangular table and two smaller square tables stacked for display.
Tops have a white surface with grey veining, resembling marble.
Frames are dark grey or black metal with a vertical ribbed texture on the legs.
Each table features a lower shelf made of a dark, reflective material, likely black glass.
A watermark 'DIVINE GRACE FURNITURE' is visible across the center of the image.
Background shows cardboard packaging and office-style chairs, suggesting a retail or warehouse setting.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a marble pattern, but it is impossible to distinguish between real stone, sintered stone, or laminate from this distance.

risks.risk: The top may be a printed laminate or 'marble-effect' board rather than real stone.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the edge and the underside of the table top.

risks.risk: The black glass lower shelves may have scratches or chips not visible in the wide shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the glass surfaces under direct light.

risks.risk: The metal frame joints may be poorly welded or unstable.
risks.proof: A video of the tables being shaken to test for wobbling.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the table top edge to confirm if it is real stone or laminate.
Clear photos of the black glass shelves to check for damage.
Video showing the tables being handled to confirm stability.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a 3-piece furniture set. It is priced as a standard faux-marble set until the material is proven to be higher-grade stone.
